name: Inverse IFEval
intro: Inverse IFEval 评估模型能否克服 SFT 形成的认知惯性并严格遵循反直觉指令。数据集覆盖 8 类指令与 23 个领域，含 1,012 条中英文问题，并使用相对人工分数验证至 98% 准确率的分类型 LLM 裁判。
org: ByteDance Seed, Nanjing University, Peking University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
build_method: SFT 范式观察与反转；专家种子；多模型多领域生成；长度与相似度过滤；专家复核与双语 rubric 校准
task_type: 反直觉指令遵循, 开放式生成
eval_feature: 8 类对抗指令, 23 领域, 双语, 分类型裁判矩阵, 人工验证
build_method_en: Observe and reverse SFT paradigms, write expert seeds, generate across domains with multiple models, filter by length/similarity, and calibrate bilingual rubrics through expert review
eval_feature_en: Eight Adversarial Instruction Types, 23 Domains, Bilingual, Type-specific Judge Matrix, Human Validation
intro_en: Inverse IFEval measures whether models can overcome cognitive inertia learned from SFT and precisely follow counterintuitive instructions. It contains 1,012 Chinese and English questions across eight instruction types and 23 domains, evaluated by type-specific LLM judges validated to 98% accuracy against human scores.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.04292 Sections 2.1-2.5 and Appendix A. The paper defines five construction stages: observation and reversal, seed data construction, large-scale generation, automatic filtering, and human verification. Common SFT paradigms are inverted into eight types: Question Correction, Intentional Textual Flaws, Code without Comments, Counter-Conventional Formatting, Deliberately Incorrect Answers, Instructional Induction, Mid-turn Instruction Modification, and Counterfactual Answering. LLM-training experts author seeds for every type; product, engineering, and operations reviewers independently vote qualified/unqualified, and only unanimously qualified seeds remain. Type-specific templates and a 23-domain taxonomy guide multiple strong LLMs to generate an initial 20 candidates per domain-type combination. Length and semantic-similarity filters remove weak candidates, targeted generation repairs underrepresented domains, and cross-model verification checks coherence. Experts then verify type consistency, clarity, ambiguity, contradictions, and fine-grained scoring rubrics. The final 1,012 examples comprise 506 English and 506 Chinese instructions with type/domain metadata and standardized rubrics. Evaluation pairs each question with two model responses and a human-verified ground-truth score. Per-type judge-model selection, template optimization, and system-prompt/few-shot enhancement raise judge accuracy from 88% to 98%.
